sources.author: Khan, Irfan Ahmad
sources.name: An Introduction to Understanding the Qur'an with Examples
sources.note: Compiled by Tanveer Azmat. Two methodological chapters plus six worked surahs (96, 103, 107, 108, 109, 112), each with Arabic text, word-by-word gloss, an outline structure, and an interpretation. Distributed by the AQU. The site's outline exercises and the per-word English glosses in data/gloss/ are transcribed from this volume.

sources.author: Farahi, Hamiduddin (Ḥamīd al-Dīn al-Farāhī)
sources.name: Mufradat al-Qur'an; Niẓām al-Qur'an wa-taʾwīl al-furqān bi-l-furqān
sources.note: Farahi's writings on Qur'anic vocabulary and discourse coherence, left unfinished at his death in 1930 and completed/edited posthumously by his students. No independently verifiable modern edition/publisher/page reference is asserted here; see the mir-coherence-1986 entry for independent secondary corroboration of these works' foundational role.

sources.author: Mir, Mustansir
sources.name: Coherence in the Qur'an: A Study of Islahi's Concept of Nazm in Tadabbur-i Qur'an
sources.note: Independent scholarly monograph (125 pp., paperback) establishing Farahi's Mufradat al-Qur'an and Niẓām al-Qur'an as the direct conceptual foundation of Islahi's nazm-based method — the second, independent source used to move the farahi-primary claim from Pending to Verified. Mir also wrote the foreword to Khan's 2013 An Exercise (see khan-exercise-2013).

sources.note: 332 pp. Computerized oral-formulaic analysis of the Qur'an. Cited as context for the site's mechanical recurring-phrase index (data/formulas-*.json): the index records recurrence; whether recurrence constitutes formulaic composition is the scholarly question this book argues.

sources.name: Structure and Qur'anic Interpretation: A Study of Symmetry and Coherence in Islam's Holy Text
sources.note: 163 pp. Analyzes Qur'anic structure through parallelism, chiasm and concentric (ring) composition. Cited alongside Cuypers as the coherence-analysis literature this site's mechanical block-structure tests (data/structure-tests.json) are context for, never a source of any transcribed outline.

sources.author: Covington, Michael A., and Joe D. McFall
sources.name: Cutting the Gordian Knot: The Moving-Average Type–Token Ratio (MATTR)
sources.publisher: Journal of Quantitative Linguistics 17, no. 2, pp. 94–100
sources.note: Source of MATTR, a length-robust alternative to raw type-token ratio used in data/numbers.json and data/surah-profiles.json alongside plain TTR, which this site's own data shows is confounded by sample size.

sources.author: McCarthy, Philip M., and Scott Jarvis
sources.name: MTLD, vocd-D, and HD-D: A validation study of sophisticated approaches to lexical diversity assessment
sources.note: Source of MTLD (factor threshold 0.72, bidirectional averaging), the second length-robust lexical-diversity measure this site reports alongside MATTR and plain TTR.

sources.author: Gries, Stefan Th.
sources.name: Dispersions and adjusted frequencies in corpora
sources.publisher: International Journal of Corpus Linguistics 13, no. 4, pp. 403–437
sources.note: Proposes the Deviation of Proportions (DP) dispersion measure and a DP-adjusted frequency, used by data/dispersion/*.json alongside Juilland's D and plain range. Amended by Lijffijt & Gries (2012), cited separately.

sources.author: Lijffijt, Jefrey, and Stefan Th. Gries
sources.name: Correction to Stefan Th. Gries' "Dispersions and adjusted frequencies in corpora"
sources.publisher: International Journal of Corpus Linguistics 17, no. 1, pp. 147–149
sources.note: Corrects the normalization of DP into DPnorm for corpora with unequal-sized parts; data/dispersion/*.json implements this corrected formula, not the 2008 original.

sources.author: Juilland, Alphonse, and Eugenio Chang-Rodríguez
sources.name: Frequency Dictionary of Spanish Words
sources.edition: The Romance Languages and their Structures, First Series, S1
sources.note: Source of Juilland's D, the older equal-parts dispersion measure reported in data/dispersion/*.json alongside Gries's DP for comparability with the wider literature.
